shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on a rough grey stone surface
animal or creature motif rendered in relief
carving concentrated in the upper portion with plainer lower area
rounded / disc-like element (A: none clear; B: concentric discs) — weak
horizontal band-like division across the surface
justification: Both are tall, weathered grey stone monoliths whose imagery is executed in shallow low relief and concentrated in the upper zone, leaving a comparatively bare lower body, which gives a similar overall silhouette impression. But A carries a single sparse quadruped in profile on an otherwise empty flat face, whereas B is densely covered with an anthropomorphic composition of head, concentric discs, bands and curvilinear motifs, so the density, subject and carving manner differ sharply.
